newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 227-day bill average yield 36.94 percent.
newsitem.headline: Russian 227-day bill average yield 36.94 percent.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 227-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 36.94 percent at an auction on Sunday, the central bank said.
The yield on an issue of 210-day T-bills on December 25 was 32.59 percent.
Sunday was a working day after a four-day New Year holiday.
Issue volume 7.50 trln rbls 7.50 trln rbls
The finance ministry also repaid around 4.58 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of three-month T-bills (series 21070).
The yield was well above current market rates. The series 22061 bills which mature on August 13 and have the closest maturity to the new paper closed on Sunday at 34.61 percent.
The new bills are subject to the existing tax regime, which makes income from government securities tax-free, finance ministry and central bank officials said.

Parliament approved a 15 percent tax on income from government securities at the end of last year but it has not yet come into force. Securities issued before the tax comes into effect will not be taxable.
